narration:0:1222674001:0.text: After a long, comfortable rest, the next morning...
narration:0:1222674001:0.source_cn: 舒舒服服地睡了一觉，第二天早上……

say:3:1222674002:0.text: That was the best sleep Chippy's had in ages!
say:3:1222674002:0.source_cn: 睡得好饱！很久没有好好休息过了！

say:4:1222674003:0.text: We've been running around for days, chasing after Bonnie, then Silvina...
say:4:1222674003:0.source_cn: 这些天又是抓波妮，又是抓西尔维娜，天天晚上追踪埋伏，昼...

say:5:1222674004:0.text: But Sonja probably didn't sleep at all last night...
say:5:1222674004:0.source_cn: 不过，索尼娅昨晚上大概一宿没睡。

choice_prompt:6:1222674004.text: But Sonja probably didn't sleep at all last night...
choice_prompt:6:1222674004.source_cn: 不过，索尼娅昨晚上大概一宿没睡。

say:7:1222674005:0.text: Yes, that relic that can control the Graveborn.
say:7:1222674005:0.source_cn: 是啊，那可是能控制亡灵的圣器。

say:8:1222674006:0.text: Even if Sonja can't use it, keeping the relic might give her leverage with the king of Bantus. On the other hand, if she destroys it, she could stop tragedies like Nara's from happening again. It's a tough one...
say:8:1222674006:0.source_cn: 就算用不上，留在手里，说不定能与骸骨之王交换利益；要是...

say:9:1222674009:0.text: Well, we've had a proper rest. Should we go see Sonja now?
say:9:1222674009:0.source_cn: 我们休息好了，要不要去看看索尼娅看看？

say:10:1222674010:0.text: If she's still feeling conflicted, maybe the great Magister Merlin can help her out!
say:10:1222674010:0.source_cn: 如果她还在纠结，伟大的魔法师梅林也能帮她权衡利弊嘛！
say:10:1222674010:0.male: If she's still feeling conflicted, maybe the great Magister Merlin can help her out!
say:10:1222674010:0.female: If she's still feeling conflicted, maybe the great Magister Merlin can help her out!

say:11:1222674011:0.text: Yes! Sonja might need your help right now. Let's go!
say:11:1222674011:0.source_cn: 没错，索尼娅这时候可能正需要主人呢！主人，我们走吧。
say:11:1222674011:0.male: Yes! Sonja might need your help right now. Let's go!
say:11:1222674011:0.female: Yes! Sonja might need your help right now. Let's go!

say:13:1222674007:0.text: But is Silvina really as cold-hearted as she looks?
say:13:1222674007:0.source_cn: 那位西尔维娜小姐，她真的是一位冷酷无情的女性吗？

say:14:1222674008:0.text: Do you think seeing her will remind Sonja of Nara again?
say:14:1222674008:0.source_cn: 看到她的时候，不知道索尼娅会不会再次想起奈拉。
